title: Recommendation Pipeline — Implementation Specification
purpose: Defines the recommendation registry as a first-class platform service. Recommendations are no longer report-only artifacts — they become traceable objects with full lifecycle management, session linking, and question-level resolution. This addresses the S809.1/S809.2 gap where recommendations existed but could not launch work.

recommendation_entity.description: A Recommendation is a first-class platform object that links a finding to executable work. It carries a full lifecycle (OPEN → CLOSED), session assignment, question references, and closure evidence.

RecommendationId.description: Globally unique. Format: REC-{SourceSession}-{NNN}. NNN is sequential within source session.

SourceSession.description: Session that discovered the finding and created the recommendation.

Priority.description: P0 = learner-pool exposure (answer-key error, structural defect on Certified item). P1 = certification-blocking. P2 = editorial quality. P3 = low-priority enhancement.

TargetSession.description: Session assigned to execute the recommendation.

LinkedQuestions.description: QuestionIDs affected. Resolved via compound-key identity.

LinkedReports.description: Report files providing evidence for the finding.

Owner.description: Persona or role responsible for execution.

ClosureEvidence.description: File reference to evidence that the recommendation was executed and verified.

Description.description: Human-readable description of the finding and recommended action.

BatchPlan.description: Proposed batch breakdown with estimated item counts per batch.

BlockedBy.description: Other RecommendationIds that must be completed first.

OPEN.description: Recommendation created but not yet assigned to a session.

ASSIGNED.description: Recommendation assigned to a target session. Work queued but not started.

IN_PROGRESS.description: Execution underway. Linked questions being remediated.

VERIFIED.description: Execution complete. Independent verification passed. Awaiting closure sign-off.

CLOSED.description: Recommendation fully executed and verified. Closure evidence recorded.

transitions.requires: ClosureEvidence file exists and is valid
ClosureEvidence referenced, defect flags updated in registry

recommendation_registry.description: Persistent store of all recommendations. Generated and maintained by the Recommendation Pipeline engine.
recommendation_registry.governance: Append-only for new recommendations. Status transitions logged. Never hand-edited.

exports.createRecommendation(finding): Generates RecommendationId, pushes to registry with status OPEN. Returns recommendation object.
exports.closeRecommendation(recommendationId, au: Status → CLOSED. ClosedDate set. Registry entry locked.
exports.getBySession(sessionId): Returns all recommendations for a session (source or target).
exports.getByQuestion(qid): Returns all recommendations linked to a question.
exports.getByStatus(status): Returns all recommendations with given status.
exports.getOpenCount(): Returns counts by priority and finding type.

strategic_outcome: Framework v2 enables: Finding → Recommendation → Session → Execution → Verification → Closure. The S809 chain (4 sessions, 60 agents, 0 writes) is prevented because recommendations block re-review of the same finding and route directly to execution.
